# Photophys data loading 

```{r photophys}
photophys <- read.csv(here("Data","AS26_PhenotypingData_expt.csv"), row.names = 1)
load(here("Data","cbb_AS26_expt_1000bs.RData"))
sample_metadata <- read.csv(here("Data","AS26_MAPPmetadata_expt.csv"), check.names = F)
# cluster object from Dendrogram.Rmd is called cbb
clusterer <- cbb

# reshape to long
longphoto_shortie <- photophys %>% 
  slice(1:1456) %>% #only keep first 1456 rows (corresponding to light stages 1-27).
  select(-c(uni, metrix)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(metric, stage, col),
    names_to = "SampleID",
    values_to = "Value")%>%
  filter(
    !str_starts(metric, "m"), #remove all -m (multiple turnover)
    !metric %in% c("Fo", "Fm") #remove Fo and Fm to prevent column shifting
  )

#remove  samples (shouldnt be a problame but kept this to check)
longphoto_shortie <- longphoto_shortie %>%
  filter(
    !(startsWith(SampleID, "t7") & 
      grepl("icra|ahya", SampleID, ignore.case = TRUE) & 
      endsWith(SampleID, "005r.processed.csv")),
    
    !(startsWith(SampleID, "t7") & 
      grepl("aglo|aabr", SampleID, ignore.case = TRUE) & 
      endsWith(SampleID, "002r.processed.csv"))
  )

longphoto_shortie <- longphoto_shortie %>%
  mutate(
    SampleID_clean = SampleID %>%
      tolower() %>%
      str_remove("\\.processed\\.csv$") %>%
      str_remove("\\.\\d+r$")
  )

#       tolower() %>%
#       str_remove("\\.processed\\.csv$"),
#       
#     base = str_extract(SampleID_clean, "^[a-z]+_?[a-z]+\\d+"),
#     num  = str_extract(SampleID_clean, "\\d+$")
#   )
# 
# longphoto_shortie <- longphoto_shortie %>%
#   mutate(
#     SampleID_fixed = paste0(
#       str_replace(base, "(\\D)(\\d+)$", "\\1_\\2")
#     )
#   )
#check if duplicates
longphoto_shortie %>%
  count(SampleID_clean, stage, col, metric) %>%
  filter(n > 1)


longphoto_shortie_fixed <- longphoto_shortie %>%
  mutate(SampleID_clean = str_remove(SampleID_clean, "\\..*"),
         SampleID_clean = str_trim(SampleID_clean)) %>% #make sure no whitesapces at end of name or name issues
  filter(SampleID_clean %in% sample_metadata$UniqueID)#only want to keep samples that we ahve metadata for (removing any that werent already filtered out) 

# This shows you the rows that will be dropped
filtered_out_samples <- longphoto_shortie_fixed %>% 
  anti_join(sample_metadata, by = c("SampleID_clean" = "UniqueID"))

# Print the unique SampleIDs that are filtered out
print(unique(filtered_out_samples$SampleID_clean))

#check if duplicates per sample, stage/col/metric: YES
longphoto_shortie_fixed %>%
  count(SampleID_clean, stage, col, metric) %>%
  filter(n > 1)


```


```{r photophys}

longphoto_wide <- longphoto_shortie_fixed %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = metric,
    values_from = Value)%>% 
  #values_fn = mean # <-- This averages.. not sure if that is right?
distinct(SampleID_clean, .keep_all = TRUE) #this one keeps just the first instance per 

longphoto_wide <- longphoto_wide[,1:16]

#get clusters from cbb using hclust
clusters <- cutree(cbb$hclust, k = 3)

cluster_df <- data.frame(
  Raw_Name = names(clusters),   # This grabs the messy "t1_aabr1.002r..." names
  Cluster = as.factor(clusters)  # This grabs the cluster group (1, 2, or 3)
) %>%
  mutate(
    # Clean up the names to match your longphoto_wide dataset
    SampleID_clean = Raw_Name %>%
      tolower() %>%
      str_remove("\\.processed\\.csv$") %>%
      str_remove("\\.\\d+r$") %>%
      str_remove("\\..*") %>%
      str_trim()
  ) %>%
  # Keep only the columns you actually need for the join
  select(SampleID_clean, Cluster)


df_with_clusters <- longphoto_wide %>%
  left_join(cluster_df, by = "SampleID_clean")
```

df_with_clusters <- df_with_clusters %>%
  mutate(across(
    # Only target numeric-looking metrics, explicitly skipping your text ID columns
    .cols = -c(SampleID, SampleID_clean, stage, col, Cluster), 
    .fns = ~ as.numeric(as.character(.x))
  ))

sum_photo <- df_with_clusters %>% 
  group_by(stage, col, Cluster) %>%
    summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean, na.rm = TRUE ))

metric_cols <- c(
  "Quant", "Sigma", "Connect",
  "Tau1", "Tau2", "NPQ",
  "qP", "ABQ", "qm",
  "nTau1", "nTau2"
)

sum_photo_long <- sum_photo %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(metric_cols),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  )

 sum_photo_long <- sum_photo %>%

     cols = -c(stage, col, Cluster), # Selects all columns except "Metric"

   )

# Plotting traces
```{r}

# individual coral trajectories
sub_photo <- sum_photo_long %>% 
  dplyr::filter(Metric != 'nTau1' & Metric !=  'nTau2' & Metric != 'nCon'& Metric != 'Fm' & Metric != 'Fo' & col != 'All' & col != 'Ratio12' & col != 'Ratio32' & col != 'Ratio42') %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(stage = as.numeric(as.character(stage))) %>% 
    dplyr::filter(stage >=1  & stage <= 27) %>% 
  arrange(stage)

# 2. Extract the branch colors assigned by color_branches
# This pulls the unique colors used for the clusters in order
#extract_cols <- unique(get_leaves_branches_col(dend))

cluster_cols <- c("1" = "#CC476B", "2" = "#9F7000", "3" = "#228B00", "4" = "#009681", "5" = "#0082CE","6" = "#B646C7", "7"= "blue", "8"= "black")
# 3. Create a clean lookup table for your ggplot

ggplot(sub_photo) + 
  geom_line(aes(x = stage, y = Value, group = interaction(col, Cluster), colour = col)) + 
  facet_grid(Metric ~ Cluster, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal() 
ggsave(plot = last_plot(), filename = "Plots/Photophys_tracesbycluster_k5.jpeg")
```
